description: Prohibition requirements (shall not). Valid under ears-x (dialect.allowProhibition=true; ast.prohibition=true), invalid under strict (ES-D-004, EARS-E016). Each line carries a per-profile expectation so a single file drives both sides of the ruling.

lines.text: The billing service shall not store raw card numbers.
While the account is delinquent, the billing service shall not issue new invoices.
When a chargeback is received, the billing service shall not retry the payment.
